reply.emotion: fresh and appetizing, holding up a ripe piece at the market
notes: Used for the edible, sweet part of a plant that contains seeds.
Do not confuse with 'el fruto', which can refer to the botanical fruit or figuratively to the result or outcome of an action.

senses.definition: Parte de las plantas que contiene las semillas y que se puede comer por su sabor dulce.

examples.text: Compro fruta fresca en el mercado cada semana.
examples.translation: I buy fresh fruit at the market every week.
examples.emotion: pleased and healthy, picking out the best produce
